title: CR Alabama Chinese Cabbage (CR Alabama F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: CR Alabama chinese cabbage is an F1 hybrid chinese cabbage variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: CR Alabama chinese cabbage is an F1 hybrid chinese cabbage variety, also sold or known as CR Alabama F1 or Alabama Chinese cabbage. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where CR Alabama chinese cabbage is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for CR Alabama F1 or Alabama Chinese cabbage, this is the same chinese cabbage. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [chinese cabbage variety finder](/crop-varieties/chinese-cabbage), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest 60 to 65 days after transplanting. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit chinese cabbage fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest 60 to 65 days after transplanting.
**Where:** Suited to the Cordillera, Dalaguete in Cebu and Lantapan in Bukidnon.
Rated intermediate against black rot, soft rot, white rust and clubroot.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual chinese cabbage on the same ground.
Where and when to plant CR Alabama chinese cabbage

Pechay Baguio heads best in cool places. In the lowlands, pick a heat tolerant hybrid and plant in the cool months. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is CR Alabama F1 the same as CR Alabama?
items.a: Yes. CR Alabama F1 is another name for CR Alabama. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CR Alabama?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
